command: const d={"project": "f584056ea8f7cc74a210f932891fde19f1d1518be7e7f4466d0c7acd11c29efe", "page": "52a8a60e5711e55b"};if((await eda.dmt_Project.getCurrentProjectInfo()).uuid!==d.project)throw Error('Wrong R2');await eda.dmt_EditorControl.openDocument(d.page);let wireLabels=0,portLabels=0;for(const w of await eda.sch_PrimitiveWire.getAll())for(const a of await eda.sch_PrimitiveAttribute.getAll(w.getState_PrimitiveId()))if(a.getState_Key()==='Name'){if(!await eda.sch_PrimitiveAttribute.modify(a,{valueVisible:false,keyVisible:false}))throw Error('Wire attr');wireLabels++;}for(const c of await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAll())if(c.getState_ComponentType()==='netport'){const pin=(await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(c.getState_PrimitiveId()))[0],rot=pin.getState_Rotation();for(const a of await eda.sch_PrimitiveAttribute.getAll(c.getState_PrimitiveId()))if(a.getState_Key()==='Name'){const x=pin.getState_X(),y=pin.getState_Y();if(!await eda.sch_PrimitiveAttribute.modify(a,{valueVisible:true,keyVisible:false,fontSize:8,rotation:0,x:rot===180?x-18:x+18,y,alignMode:rot===180?8:2}))throw Error('Port attr');portLabels++;}}return {page:d.page,wireLabels,portLabels};
